node.title: Re: Looking for a function that returns status of a scalar's numeric flags
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You could probably use use B qw/svref_2object/; my $flags = svref_2object(\$val)->FLAGS;, but [Tux]'s [mod://Data::Peek] seems to have pretty nice interface:

use warnings; use strict; use Data::Dump; use Data::Peek qw/DDump/; my $x = "2.7"; dd {DDump $x}->{FLAGS}; dd $x; # changes flags dd {DDump $x}->{FLAGS}; __END__ { IsCOW => 1, POK => 1, pPOK => 1 } 2.7 { IsCOW => 1, NOK => 1, pIOK => 1, pNOK => 1, POK => 1, pPOK => 1 }
